data.description: Morgana, codename Mona, is a member of the Phantom Thieves of Hearts, a group of Persona users based in Japan. They accomplish this by travelling to a dimension called the Metaverse, where they can enter the subconcious minds of their targets. Morgana is one of the founding members and second-in-command. Though he used to desire to become a human, his wish was briefly granted, and afterwards he realized that he's happier as a cat. He is skilled with a cutlass sword and a slingshot, and his Persona, Zorro, fights at his side with a lance sword, and can evolve into two more powerful forms, Mercurius and Diego.
